description: Run the configured test command (testCommand in .cpfs/config-mcp.json) for the active feature attempt and append a VALIDATION block to the log. Returns pass/fail, exit code, and output tail. Respects the soft-block (pending out-of-scope edits) gate. Parity with the extension's validateAttempt command (the vscode modal is replaced by a structured block reason).

feature.description: Feature slug; omit for the active feature.
